items.quote: Renn led community engagement on the estate renewal plan across the department.
Renn set the direction for accountability arrangements for public funds across the public service.
He led presentations to senior management across the department.
Renn Wilari led teamwork across departments on the annual review across the department.
He contributed effectively to coaching and mentoring junior officers.
He drove policy options for the cabinet paper on ageing for the whole division.
He set the direction for cost savings across procurement across the public service.
Renn championed long-term strategy for the sector and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
